sql: SELECT metric, val FROM ( SELECT 'cohort:'||c.number||':'||c.status metric, to_char(c.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') val, 1 o FROM evo_cohorts c ORDER BY c.number DESC LIMIT 3 ) x UNION ALL SELECT 'agents:'||status, count(*)::text, 2 FROM evo_agents GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'agents_born_last_24h', count(*)::text, 3 FROM evo_agents WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY 3, 1
